description: Operator console for a Frontier Commerce deployment: payments, entitlements, treasury reconciliation, gas sponsor and indexer health across ALL merchants of the deployment (product ids restart at 1 per merchant, so every merchant-scoped panel is keyed by merchant). Fed by the observability collector into the frontier_commerce Postgres schema. Truth layers: payments/entitlements = indexed events; treasury/product/pause panels = sampled on-chain reads; sponsor/poller panels = runtime health.

panels.title: At a glance — is Frontier Commerce healthy?

panels.description: ON-CHAIN truth (sampled every 10 min): the registry pause flag plus EVERY configured merchant's pause flag. PAUSED means payments are refused at the Move layer for at least one merchant — check the deployment table below to see which.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(ts) AS "time", CASE WHEN bool_or(registry_paused) OR bool_or(merchant_paused) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS value FROM frontier_commerce.chain_status;

panels.title: Commerce state

panels.description: RUNTIME health: seconds since the last successful commerce event poll (target: every 60s). Red = the commerce indexer has stopped.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", extract(epoch FROM (now() - last_success_at)) AS value FROM frontier_commerce.poller_status WHERE id = 1;

panels.title: Indexer freshness

panels.description: RUNTIME health: consecutive pollOnce() failures. See "Indexer & collector" row for the error text.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", consecutive_errors AS value FROM frontier_commerce.poller_status WHERE id = 1;

panels.title: Poll failures (consecutive)

panels.description: RUNTIME health: latest probe of the sponsor /health endpoint over the private docker network.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", CASE WHEN ok THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM frontier_commerce.sponsor_health ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Gas sponsor

panels.description: ON-CHAIN truth via the station: sponsor SUI float. Station low-balance threshold is 0.3 SUI (testnet float ~1.5 SUI).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", balance_mist / 1e9 AS value FROM frontier_commerce.sponsor_health WHERE ok ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Sponsor balance

panels.description: RUNTIME health: worst-case gas budget charged today vs DAILY_BUDGET_SUI. 100% = sponsorships refused until UTC midnight.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", CASE WHEN daily_budget_mist > 0 THEN 100.0 * day_spend_mist / daily_budget_mist END AS value FROM frontier_commerce.sponsor_health WHERE ok ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Daily gas budget used

panels.description: Event-derived expected treasury vs on-chain treasury_value for EVERY merchant and currency in the latest reconciliation snapshot. MISMATCH means at least one pair disagrees — investigate before trusting either side (per-merchant rows in the Treasury & accounting row below).

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT * FROM frontier_commerce.treasury_recon
  WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM frontier_commerce.treasury_recon) AND onchain_mist IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT max(ts) AS "time",
       CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL WHEN bool_and(ok) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value
FROM latest;

panels.title: Treasury reconciliation

panels.description: INDEXED truth: (owner, key) pairs whose latest event is a grant with an unexpired expiry. The worker's enforcement check is the on-chain is_entitled view.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", count(*) AS value FROM frontier_commerce.entitlement_status WHERE active;

panels.title: Active entitlements

panels.description: INDEXED truth.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", count(*) AS value FROM frontier_commerce.payments WHERE paid_at > now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.title: Payments (24h)

panels.description: INDEXED truth.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", count(*) AS value FROM frontier_commerce.payments WHERE paid_at > now() - interval '7 days';

panels.title: Payments (7d)

panels.description: INDEXED truth: gross EVE payments in the last 7 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", COALESCE(sum(amount_raw), 0) / 1e9 AS value FROM frontier_commerce.payments WHERE paid_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND currency LIKE '%${currency}';

panels.title: Revenue 7d (primary currency)

panels.description: INDEXED truth: gross EVE payments since deployment.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", COALESCE(sum(amount_raw), 0) / 1e9 AS value FROM frontier_commerce.payments WHERE currency LIKE '%${currency}';

panels.title: Revenue all-time (primary currency)

panels.description: INDEXED truth: hours since the most recent payment. Informational — quiet periods are normal on testnet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", extract(epoch FROM (now() - max(paid_at))) / 3600.0 AS value FROM frontier_commerce.payments;

panels.title: Last payment age

panels.description: INDEXED truth: active entitlements that lapse within 7 days (renewal candidates / imminent lockouts).

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", count(*) AS value FROM frontier_commerce.entitlement_status WHERE active AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < now() + interval '7 days';

panels.title: Entitlements expiring ≤7d

panels.description: INDEXED truth: rows in the commerce event ledger (all event types).

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", total_events AS value FROM frontier_commerce.poller_status WHERE id = 1;

panels.title: Total commerce events

panels.description: RUNTIME health: age of the newest sponsor-health snapshot — a proxy for "is the ef-commerce-obs collector alive at all".

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", extract(epoch FROM (now() - max(ts))) AS value FROM frontier_commerce.sponsor_health;

panels.title: Grafana feed freshness

panels.description: One row per configured merchant. Descriptor columns (network, package, registry) come from the deployment JSON baked into the collector; pause flags and counters are ON-CHAIN truth sampled every 10 min. IDs link to Suiscan.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.network, d.chain_id, c.merchant_name, c.merchant_id,
       c.registry_fee_bps AS fee_bps, c.registry_paused, c.merchant_paused,
       c.next_payment_id - 1 AS payments_made,
       d.package_id, d.registry_id, d.sponsor_address,
       c.ts AS chain_sampled_at, c.error
FROM frontier_commerce.chain_status c
CROSS JOIN frontier_commerce.deployment_info d
WHERE d.id = 1
ORDER BY c.merchant_name;

panels.title: Deployment — what production is using

panels.description: ON-CHAIN truth via catalog::product_info (sampled every 10 min) for every product of every configured merchant. Product ids restart at 1 per merchant, so merchant + product_id is the key — never product_id alone.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(c.merchant_name, left(p.merchant_id, 12)) AS merchant,
       p.product_id, p.slug, p.entitlement_key, p.active,
       CASE p.kind WHEN 1 THEN 'one-time' WHEN 2 THEN 'subscription' ELSE p.kind::text END AS kind,
       p.price_raw / 1e9 AS price, p.coin_symbol,
       p.duration_ms / 86400000.0 AS duration_days,
       p.updated_at AS chain_sampled_at, p.error
FROM frontier_commerce.product_status p
LEFT JOIN frontier_commerce.chain_status c ON c.merchant_id = p.merchant_id
ORDER BY merchant, p.product_id;

panels.title: Products (on-chain catalog state)

panels.description: INDEXED truth from PaymentEvent, stacked per merchant.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(paid_at, '1d') AS time,
       COALESCE(merchant_name, left(merchant_id, 12)) AS metric,
       count(*) AS payments
FROM frontier_commerce.payments_labeled
WHERE $__timeFilter(paid_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Payments per day by merchant

panels.description: INDEXED truth from PaymentEvent, stacked per merchant/product (smoke-test MOCK payments excluded). Product slug comes from the on-chain catalog sample, so a product the collector has not sampled yet shows as "product <id>".

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(paid_at, '1d') AS time,
       COALESCE(merchant_name, left(merchant_id, 12)) || ' / ' ||
         COALESCE(product_slug, 'product ' || product_id::text) AS metric,
       sum(amount_raw) / 1e9 AS value
FROM frontier_commerce.payments_labeled
WHERE $__timeFilter(paid_at) AND currency LIKE '%${currency}'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Gross revenue per day by product (primary currency)

panels.description: INDEXED truth. gas_sponsored = gas owner ≠ sender (ON-CHAIN, fetched per tx); true means your sponsor (or another third party) paid the gas. Click payer / tx_digest for Suiscan; use panel inspect (hover → eye) to copy full values.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT paid_at, COALESCE(merchant_name, left(merchant_id, 12)) AS merchant,
       COALESCE(product_slug, 'product ' || product_id::text) AS product,
       payer, amount_raw / 1e9 AS amount,
       CASE WHEN currency LIKE '%${currency}' THEN 'EVE' WHEN currency LIKE '%${currency_smoke}' THEN 'MOCK' ELSE currency END AS coin,
       payment_id, external_ref, sponsored AS gas_sponsored, gas_owner, tx_digest
FROM frontier_commerce.payments_labeled ORDER BY paid_at DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Recent payments
Revenue attribution — which merchant, product and app the money came from

panels.description: INDEXED truth: every PaymentEvent grouped by the merchant and product that received it. This is the answer to "what is each product earning". Product ids restart per merchant, so the merchant column is part of the identity. gross is not net of refunds — the reconciliation panels are the accounting truth.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(merchant_name, left(merchant_id, 12)) AS merchant,
       COALESCE(product_slug, 'product ' || product_id::text) AS product,
       CASE WHEN currency LIKE '%${currency}' THEN 'EVE' WHEN currency LIKE '%${currency_smoke}' THEN 'MOCK' ELSE currency END AS coin,
       count(*) AS payments,
       sum(amount_raw) / 1e9 AS gross,
       count(DISTINCT payer) AS wallets,
       min(paid_at) AS first_payment,
       max(paid_at) AS last_payment
FROM frontier_commerce.payments_labeled
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY gross DESC;

panels.title: Revenue by merchant and product (all-time)

panels.description: INDEXED truth grouped by the external_ref prefix (everything before the first ":"). Apps that namespace their refs as "<app>:<order>:<n>" get per-app revenue for free — including several apps sharing ONE product, which no product-level split can separate. external_ref is opaque to the chain (uniqueness is app-enforced), so treat this as an app-side convention, not a guarantee.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ref_prefix AS app,
       ref_prefix,
       CASE WHEN currency LIKE '%${currency}' THEN 'EVE' WHEN currency LIKE '%${currency_smoke}' THEN 'MOCK' ELSE currency END AS coin,
       count(*) AS payments,
       sum(amount_raw) / 1e9 AS gross,
       count(DISTINCT payer) AS wallets,
       max(paid_at) AS last_payment
FROM frontier_commerce.payments_labeled
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY gross DESC;

panels.title: Revenue by app (external_ref namespace)
Entitlements (indexed truth — enforcement itself reads the chain)

panels.description: INDEXED truth: newest grant/revoke per (owner, key); subscription grants carry the new absolute expiry (extend-from-max). 'active' here can briefly differ from the worker's cached on-chain check — the chain view entitlements::is_entitled is authoritative.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT owner, key, active, expires_at,
       round(((expires_at_ms - extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000) / 86400000.0)::numeric, 1) AS days_left,
       last_event, last_event_at, last_tx_digest
FROM frontier_commerce.entitlement_status
ORDER BY active DESC, expires_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200;

panels.title: Entitlement status by wallet (latest event wins)

panels.description: INDEXED truth: every grant/extension (EntitlementGrantedEvent — source_payment_id links it to the paying payment; NULL = operator-granted) and revoke (by_refund distinguishes refund-driven from operator revoke).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT at, event_name, owner, key, expires_at, source_payment_id, by_refund, tx_digest
FROM frontier_commerce.entitlement_events ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Recent entitlement events

panels.description: ON-CHAIN truth: treasury_value summed across ALL merchants (withdrawable earnings), sampled every 10 min. Per-merchant split in the table to the right.
panels.title: On-chain treasury (primary currency)

panels.description: INDEXED truth, summed across ALL merchants: gross payments - fees - refunds + net credit charges - withdrawals - distributions, from the event ledger.
panels.title: Expected treasury (events)

panels.description: on-chain - expected, summed across ALL merchants. Anything but 0 is a reconciliation failure — the per-merchant table shows which one.
panels.title: Recon delta (primary currency)

panels.description: ON-CHAIN truth: fees_accrued_value summed across ALL merchants — protocol cut awaiting sweep (with fee_bps 0, expect 0).
panels.title: Protocol fees accrued (primary currency)

panels.description: INDEXED truth: RefundEvent count, all time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", count(*) AS value FROM frontier_commerce.refunds;

panels.title: Refunds (count)

panels.description: INDEXED truth: withdrawal / split-distribution / fee-sweep events, all time (0 = nothing has ever left the treasury).

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", count(*) AS value FROM frontier_commerce.raw_events WHERE event_name IN ('TreasuryWithdrawalEvent', 'SplitDistributedEvent', 'FeesSweptEvent');

panels.title: Treasury withdrawals

panels.description: Both lines sum every merchant at each sample and should sit on top of each other. Divergence = indexer gap or unaccounted treasury movement; the reconciliation table attributes it to a merchant.
panels.title: Treasury: on-chain vs expected (primary currency, all merchants)

panels.description: Latest reconciliation row per merchant and currency — this is where a MISMATCH at the top becomes actionable. unattributed_refunds > 0 would mean per-currency reconciliation is unreliable (legacy events): surface, never ignore.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.merchant_id, t.currency)
       COALESCE(c.merchant_name, left(t.merchant_id, 12)) AS merchant,
       CASE WHEN currency LIKE '%${currency}' THEN 'EVE' WHEN currency LIKE '%${currency_smoke}' THEN 'MOCK' ELSE currency END AS coin,
       t.payment_count, t.refund_count, t.grants, t.revocations,
       t.expected_mist / 1e9 AS expected, t.onchain_mist / 1e9 AS onchain, t.delta / 1e9 AS delta,
       t.unattributed_refunds, t.ts AS sampled_at, t.error
FROM frontier_commerce.treasury_recon t
LEFT JOIN frontier_commerce.chain_status c ON c.merchant_id = t.merchant_id
ORDER BY t.merchant_id, t.currency, t.ts DESC;

panels.title: Ledger aggregates by merchant and currency (latest reconciliation)

panels.description: Sponsor float. Red line = 0.3 SUI low-balance threshold; the station keeps sponsoring below it but this is the refill signal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, balance_mist / 1e9 AS "balance (SUI)"
FROM frontier_commerce.sponsor_health WHERE ok AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: Sponsor SUI balance

panels.description: Worst-case gas budget charged per sponsorship, reset at UTC midnight (and on station restart — in-memory counter).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, day_spend_mist / 1e9 AS "spent today", daily_budget_mist / 1e9 AS "daily budget"
FROM frontier_commerce.sponsor_health WHERE ok AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts;

panels.title: Daily gas budget spend (SUI)

panels.description: Station lifetime counters differenced per snapshot (~1 min). Counters reset when the station restarts (see "Station started"); the reset minute clamps to 0.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, greatest(approved - la, 0) AS approved, greatest(rejected - lr, 0) AS rejected,
       greatest(depleted - ld, 0) AS depleted, greatest(errors - le, 0) AS errors
FROM (
  SELECT ts AS time, approved, lag(approved) OVER w AS la, rejected, lag(rejected) OVER w AS lr,
         depleted, lag(depleted) OVER w AS ld, errors, lag(errors) OVER w AS le
  FROM frontier_commerce.sponsor_health WHERE ok WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY ts)
) s WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Sponsorship outcomes (delta per snapshot)

panels.description: Since last station restart.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", approved AS value FROM frontier_commerce.sponsor_health WHERE ok ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Approved (station lifetime)

panels.description: Policy/rate/deny-list/budget rejections since last station restart. A burst here with users complaining = policy or abuse problem.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", rejected AS value FROM frontier_commerce.sponsor_health WHERE ok ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Rejected (station lifetime)

panels.description: Internal sponsor errors since last restart (includes failed health RPC reads).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", errors AS value FROM frontier_commerce.sponsor_health WHERE ok ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Errors (station lifetime)

panels.description: In-flight reserved gas coins (30s TTL). Persistently > 0 with no traffic = stuck reservations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", pool_reserved AS value FROM frontier_commerce.sponsor_health WHERE ok ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Gas pool reserved (now)

panels.description: Hours since the sponsor process started. Drops to 0 = restart (lifetime counters reset).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", extract(epoch FROM (now() - station_started_at)) / 3600.0 AS value FROM frontier_commerce.sponsor_health WHERE ok AND station_started_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Station started

panels.description: Failed /health probes in the last 24h.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS "time", count(*) AS value FROM frontier_commerce.sponsor_health WHERE NOT ok AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.title: Sponsor probe failures (24h)

panels.description: INDEXED truth: everything the frontier-commerce package emits (payments, entitlements, catalog, caps, treasury).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000.0), '1d') AS time, event_name AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM frontier_commerce.raw_events WHERE $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000.0)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Commerce events by type per day

panels.description: RUNTIME health of the canonical frontier-commerce indexer loop (ef-commerce-obs container).
panels.title: Poller state + last error

panels.description: Empty is good.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, kind, detail FROM frontier_commerce.collector_runs WHERE NOT ok ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Collector job failures (30d)
Support lookup — paste a wallet or tx digest in the variables above

options.content:
1. **Paste the wallet** (or tx digest) into the **wallet / digest** boxes at the top; every panel in this row filters to it.
2. **Did the payment land?** → *Payments for filter*. No row: the transaction never succeeded on-chain (check the digest on an explorer) **or** the indexer is stale (check *Indexer freshness* up top). Row present: note `gas_sponsored` (did your sponsor pay gas?) and the `merchant` + `product` columns (product ids restart at 1 per merchant, so check both; make sure it is the REAL product, not a smoke/validation product — smoke currency never unlocks the real entitlement if you kept the keys distinct).
3. **Was the entitlement granted?** → *Entitlement events for filter* should show an `EntitlementGrantedEvent` in the same tx, with your entitlement key and the new expiry.
4. **Is it active now?** → *Entitlement status for filter*: `active` + `expires_at`. Expired / revoked → that is the answer. **Note:** this is INDEXED truth; your app should enforce the on-chain `entitlements::is_entitled` view — a user unlocked seconds ago may need your app's cache TTL or a fresh session before the UI updates.
5. **Everything above green but the user is still locked?** → it is an app identity/session problem, not commerce: the wallet the user is signed in with differs from the paying wallet, or your app-side session/device state is stale. That state lives in YOUR app, deliberately not mirrored here.
6. **Treasury recon MISMATCH** at the top at the same time → distrust the ledger, verify the tx on an explorer directly and check *Collector job failures*.

*Layer key: payments/entitlements here = indexed event ledger · pause flags, product state, treasury values = sampled on-chain reads · sponsor & poller panels = runtime health.*

panels.title: Playbook: “the user paid but is still locked”

panels.description: All payment history matching the wallet/digest filter (unfiltered when both boxes are empty).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT paid_at, COALESCE(merchant_name, left(merchant_id, 12)) AS merchant,
       COALESCE(product_slug, 'product ' || product_id::text) AS product,
       payer, beneficiary, amount_raw / 1e9 AS amount,
       CASE WHEN currency LIKE '%${currency}' THEN 'EVE' WHEN currency LIKE '%${currency_smoke}' THEN 'MOCK' ELSE currency END AS coin,
       payment_id, external_ref, sponsored AS gas_sponsored, gas_owner, tx_status, tx_digest
FROM frontier_commerce.payments_labeled
WHERE ('$wallet' = '' OR payer ILIKE '%' || trim('$wallet') || '%' OR beneficiary ILIKE '%' || trim('$wallet') || '%') AND ('$digest' = '' OR tx_digest = trim('$digest'))
ORDER BY paid_at DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Payments for filter

panels.description: Current entitlement state (indexed) for the wallet filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT owner, key, active, expires_at,
       round(((expires_at_ms - extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000) / 86400000.0)::numeric, 1) AS days_left,
       last_event, last_event_at, last_tx_digest
FROM frontier_commerce.entitlement_status
WHERE ('$wallet' = '' OR owner ILIKE '%' || trim('$wallet') || '%')
ORDER BY last_event_at DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Entitlement status for filter

panels.description: Grant/extend/revoke history for the wallet/digest filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT at, event_name, owner, key, expires_at, source_payment_id, by_refund, tx_digest
FROM frontier_commerce.entitlement_events
WHERE ('$wallet' = '' OR owner ILIKE '%' || trim('$wallet') || '%') AND ('$digest' = '' OR tx_digest = trim('$digest'))
ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Entitlement events for filter

panels.description: Full event payloads for a wallet or digest — the "show me everything the chain said" panel. Empty until a filter is set.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000.0) AS at, event_name, tx_digest, json::text AS event_json
FROM frontier_commerce.raw_events
WHERE ('$digest' <> '' AND tx_digest = trim('$digest'))
   OR ('$wallet' <> '' AND (json->>'payer' ILIKE '%' || trim('$wallet') || '%'
        OR json->>'owner' ILIKE '%' || trim('$wallet') || '%'
        OR json->>'beneficiary' ILIKE '%' || trim('$wallet') || '%'
        OR json->>'to' ILIKE '%' || trim('$wallet') || '%'))
ORDER BY timestamp_ms DESC LIMIT 200;
